answer_1.quote: feedback comment generation is a task of text-to-text generation. It then can be abstractly regarded as a Machine Translation (MT) problem where the input text ... is translated into another text explaining writing rules.
answer_1.outputs: feedback comment strings (explanatory notes) limited to <100 tokens, or the special token <NO COMMENT>

answer_2.quote: In the former, we simply take BLEU between a system output and its corresponding reference (manually created feedback comment).

answer_4.quote: human evaluators examine whether a system output and its corresponding reference are equivalent in meaning. To be precise, a system output is regarded as appropriate if (1) it contains information similar to the reference and (2) it does not contain information that is irrelevant to the span; ... we trained a professional annotator ... and the first and third authors independently evaluated the generation results.
answer_4.guideline: System outputs are judged as appropriate if they contain information similar to the reference and do not contain irrelevant information to the span.
